lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2Pd2O8 (MnPO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mn centers with octahedral O coordination (six neighbors, 2.03–2.04 Å) and P centers in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors (1.55–1.59 Å), while O centers have three geometric neighbors (one Mn, two P). The connectivity forms a two-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and P tetrahedra, with edge-sharing also observed between Mn octahedra.
